name: @yun520-1/heartflow
description: HeartFlow (心虫) — AGI Layer 1: the Discriminator. Rule-based engine that checks what AI says before it reaches humans. 292 discrimination dimensions, 11-layer pipeline, 169 modules (logic/decision/cognition/emotion/memory/ethics/collaboration), 198 MCP tools, 1,390 dispatch routes. Zero LLM dependency. The gate that says NO when something is wrong.

scripts.status: curl -sS --noproxy '*' --max-time 8 -f http://127.0.0.1:8588/health | node -e "let s='';process.stdin.on('data',d=>s+=d).on('end',()=>{let j;try{j=JSON.parse(s)}catch(e){console.error('heartflow status: /health 返回非 JSON（服务可能已坏）');process.exit(1)}if(j.status!=='ok'){console.error('heartflow status: /health 报 status='+j.status+'，服务不健康');process.exit(1)}console.log(JSON.stringify({status:'ok',version:j.version,clients:j.clients,source:'http://127.0.0.1:8588/health'},null,2))})" || { echo 'heartflow status: 读不到 127.0.0.1:8588/health（端口未监听 / 服务未运行 / 已挂死）；启动用 npm start'; exit 1; }

security.audit: mathjs and @xenova/transformers are loaded lazily inside try/catch and degrade gracefully when absent. js-yaml and pm2 declarations were removed (zero references in src/).
warnings: No automatic external data transmission. All network communication requires explicit configuration.
No automatic API key injection. Users must provide keys explicitly.
Benchmark MCP tools enforce guardPath confinement; git commands run parameterized (no shell interpolation).
